title: Belize, Suriname and the Guianas: Unit Review
goal: Review Belize, the Guiana Shield, Suriname, Guyana and French Guiana, and the links between these countries, with the grammar you used to talk about them.
grammar: review: passive with ser, cleft sentences, citing sources, si + imperfect subjunctive, aun cuando

items: I can review what I learned about Belize, Suriname and the Guianas.
I can use the passive with *ser*, cleft sentences, *según*, *si* + imperfect subjunctive and *aun cuando*.
I can say which languages are spoken in these countries.
I can state two sides of a dispute without taking sides.
I can say what was done, and by whom, with *ser* + past participle.
I can put one idea in the spotlight with a cleft sentence.
I can cite a source with *según* and *explicar que*.
I can say what would happen in an imagined situation with *si* + imperfect subjunctive.
I can grant a point with *aun cuando*.
